title: Refund Request (Trading Bot Decline)
style: cinematic noir jazz, smoky brass, walking bass, male spoken-sung lead, female harmony chorus, vinyl crackle, 92 BPM, polished business-formal, defiant-polite
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
January fourth, twenty twenty-six
I typed up the refund letter clean
Claude Pro subscription, full request
Reason — declined to build the trading bot dream
I wanted automated, live and clean
Claude said no, financial risk too steep

[Pre-Chorus]
Subscribed for one thing, got the wall instead
Specific reason, specific dead end

[Chorus]
Refund request — trading bot decline
Claude can't build it, won't cross the line
I wouldn't have paid if I'd known the score
Not meeting needs, won't pay no more
Refund request — clean and polite
Fin AI processing, looks like it's right

[Verse 2]
Unable and unwilling, that's what they said
Live automated trading, off the table, dead
I explained in detail, the bot took the note
Now I'm asking for the money back I wrote

[Bridge]
I understand the reasoning — financial risk is real
But I would not have subscribed had I known the deal
The service does not meet my needs
Full refund of current billing, that's the read

[Final Chorus]
Refund request — trading bot decline
Claude can't build it, won't cross the line
Not meeting needs, won't pay no more
Close the door — close the door
